map.毛保费计算器。输入纯保费与附加费率，按 毛保费 = 纯保费×(1+附加费率) 求: Gross premium calculator. Enter the net premium and loading rate and compute the gross premium as gross premium = net premium x (1 + loading rate), for accounting expense loadings in insurance pricing.
map.毛保费 = 纯保费 × (1+附加费率): Gross premium = net premium x (1 + loading rate)
map.输入纯保费与附加费率，求毛保费。: Enter the net premium and loading rate to find the gross premium.
map.纯保费加费用、利润安全边际得到毛保费。: Adding expenses, profit and safety margin to the net premium gives the gross premium.
map.调附加费率看保费涨幅。: Adjust the loading rate to see the premium increase.
map.：毛保费 = 10×(1+0.4) = 14。即每单位风险毛保费 14，其中 4: : Gross premium = 10 x (1 + 0.4) = 14. That is, the gross premium per unit of risk is 14, of which 4 is loading for expenses and profit.

map.附加费率含哪些？: What does the loading rate include?
map.费用(获取+维持)、预期利润、风险安全边际。40% 是常见区间，渠道不同差异大。: Expenses (acquisition plus maintenance), expected profit, risk safety margin. 40% is a common range, and it varies a lot by channel.
map.偏高。附加费率含佣金（首年常20%–40%）、营运、税金、利润与安全边际；长期保: On the high side. The loading rate covers commission (often 20%-40% in the first year), operations, taxes, profit and safety margin; for long-term protection products the loading share is usually 15%-30%, and unit-linked or online sales can be lower.
